name: hero-party-front
prompt: This is Luna, the real woman under the city AI's version of her: about 27, tall and slim, with adult proportions and long legs, standing exactly as in the first reference, at the same size in the frame. Her face pale and tired, with plain lips and no make-up; her dull ash-blonde hair in its plain, fairly thin high ponytail. Seen from the front: over her right eye only, which is on the viewer's left, her old goggle, one round amber-orange lens in a dark bronze frame on a thin dark strap around her head. Her left eye, on the viewer's right, is bare: a plain tired grey-green eye with nothing over it. Her ponytail is behind her head, out of sight but for a little hair at the sides. She wears the best she has: a cheap, faded black party dress from a second-hand stall, a few of its sequins missing, with long sleeves and a high round neckline, covering her stomach completely, fitted to the waist, its skirt hanging loose to just above her knees; sheer black tights and scuffed black shoes with a low block heel. The same flat-shaded style: two or three flat tones per surface, crisp edges, no texture.
concierge: Luna as the city AI shows her: the same beautiful woman, standing exactly as in the first reference, her curvy figure with a full bust, her glossy black hair in a high ponytail with hot-pink and teal streaks. Seen from the front: over her right eye only, which is on the viewer's left, the sleek visor of glowing ice-blue light covers that one eye and nothing else; her left eye, on the viewer's right, is uncovered and made up. A glamorous party dress of shimmering violet with long sleeves and a high round neckline, covering her stomach completely, fitted to the waist, its skirt hanging loose to just above her knees; sheer black tights and elegant black heels. Bold make-up and glossy lips. The same flat-shaded style.
framing: One full-length figure seen straight from the front, facing the viewer, standing in a relaxed neutral pose: arms hanging at her sides, slightly away from the body, hands empty and open, legs straight and a little apart, the coat open and hanging straight down. Feet at the bottom of the frame. Even, soft, frontal lighting with no cast shadows and no rim light. Transparent background, the whole figure in frame with a little space around it, no ground, no text, no border.
